_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "heading" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "term" TEXT NOT NULL, "reading" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("term", "reading"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dictionary" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "format_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "order" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "is_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_hidden" IN (0, 1)), "is_collapsed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_collapsed" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entry" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "heading_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heading (id), "dictionary_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES dictionary (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "definitions" TEXT NOT NULL, "popularity" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pitch" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "heading_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heading (id), "dictionary_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES dictionary (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "downstep" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "frequency" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "heading_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heading (id), "dictionary_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES dictionary (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "display_value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tag" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dictionary_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES dictionary (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "sorting_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL, "popularity" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("dictionary_id", "name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "heading_tag" ("heading_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heading (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tag (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("heading_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entry_tag" ("entry_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES entry (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tag (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("entry_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_item" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "media_source_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "image_url" TEXT NULL, "source_metadata" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration" INTEGER NOT NULL, "can_delete" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("can_delete" IN (0, 1)), "can_edit" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("can_edit" IN (0, 1)), "override_title" TEXT NULL, "last_opened_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("media_source_identifier", "media_identifier"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stash_item" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "media_item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES media_item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "term" TEXT NOT NULL, "reading" TEXT NOT NULL, "dictionary_name" TEXT NULL, "definitions" TEXT NOT NULL, "sentence" TEXT NOT NULL, "word_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "word_length" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date_added" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("media_item_id", "term", "reading"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "anki_mapping" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "label" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "order" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "export_field_keys" TEXT NOT NULL, "creator_field_keys" TEXT NOT NULL, "creator_collapsed_field_keys" TEXT NOT NULL, "tags" TEXT NOT NULL, "enhancements" TEXT NOT NULL, "export_media_tags" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("export_media_tags" IN (0, 1)), "use_br_tags" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("use_br_tags" IN (0, 1)), "prepend_dictionary_names" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("prepend_dictionary_names" IN (0, 1)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mokuro_catalog" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "order" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_history_item" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "search_term" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dictionary_history" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "search_term" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "search_with_wildcards" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("search_with_wildcards" IN (0, 1)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preference" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX heading_reading ON heading (reading)
CREATE INDEX entry_heading_id ON entry (heading_id)
CREATE INDEX entry_dictionary_id ON entry (dictionary_id)
CREATE INDEX pitch_heading_id ON pitch (heading_id)
CREATE INDEX pitch_dictionary_id ON pitch (dictionary_id)
CREATE INDEX frequency_heading_id ON frequency (heading_id)
CREATE INDEX frequency_dictionary_id ON frequency (dictionary_id)
CREATE INDEX heading_tag_tag_id ON heading_tag (tag_id)
CREATE INDEX entry_tag_tag_id ON entry_tag (tag_id)
